task.description: Re-verify REQ-226's reworked design genuinely removes all literal implementation code while preserving full information content.

result.note: Independently re-read the current §3.2 (lines 216-238) directly: the literal `@primary_key {...}` + `schema "entity_definitions" do ... end` block is gone, replaced by a primary-key prose sentence and a Field/Ecto-field-type/Source-column markdown table plus a timestamps prose sentence -- no `schema`, `@primary_key` macro call, or `field :x, :type` DSL line remains anywhere in the section. Information-completeness check against my own first-pass requirements: all 8 fields present (tenant_id, name, display_name, definition_json, content_hash, logical_shape_version, artifact_version_id, status) with correct Ecto types; `status`'s `Ecto.Enum` values `[:active, :inactive]` explicitly stated in the table; `artifact_version_id`'s FK relationship is covered by the immediately-following (unchanged) `foreign_key_constraint(:artifact_version_id)` sentence, cross-referenced to Activation's own idiom; `timestamps(updated_at: false)` convention explicitly named with its cross-reference to §1.2/§1.4 and the repository_artifacts/artifact_versions precedent. Nothing was silently dropped. Independently ran `grep -n '^```'` myself (did not trust CODE-DESIGNER's self-report) and got 8 fenced blocks at lines 251, 265, 303, 313, 324, 337, 387, 397; inspected each block's content directly -- all are `@type`/`@spec` declarations (create_attrs/create_error/create_definition spec; get_definition/get_definition_by_name specs; list_definitions_filters/list_definitions spec; activate_definition spec) with zero `def ... do ... end` or `schema ... do ... end` bodies among them. `git diff 515a6412..23245609 -- lib/letflow/design/req226-entity-definitions-persistence-crud.md` shows the change is scoped exactly to §3.2's schema-block-to-prose-table replacement -- no other lines in the document changed, confirming function-signature accuracy (§3.3), activation reuse (§3.4), and tenant-scoping (§3.3 step 5 / §3.4) sections are byte-identical to the version I already passed in step-01b and do not need re-verification. Rework is complete and correctly scoped; design is approved to proceed to ELIXIR-DEV.
